chunks: And it is narrated: “That ʿAlī عليه السلام passed by a tall minaret and ordered it to be demolished,
then he said: ‘The minaret should not be raised except level with the roof of the mosque.’
ai.seo_question: What did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام say about raising a mosque’s minaret above its roof?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام objected to a minaret being built excessively high and ordered its demolition. It indicates a ruling or guideline concerning mosque construction, specifically that the minaret should not be raised above the level of the mosque’s roof.
